label: Microsoft Xbox Series X
description: 1 TB Xbox Series X console with one Ethernet port rated 802.3 10/100/1000 - a single gigabit RJ45 - and dual-band 802.11ac (Wi-Fi 5) wireless, plus a dedicated Xbox Wireless radio for controllers that is not an 802.11 interface. Physical layout is HDMI 2.1 out, three USB 3.1 Gen 1 ports, the Ethernet port and an AC inlet; the console is mains powered with no PoE and no second NIC.
notes: Microsoft's 'PORTS & CONNECTIVITY' block: 'HDMI: 1x HDMI 2.1 port, USB: 3x USB 3.1 Gen 1 ports, Wireless: 802.11ac dual band, Ethernet: 802.3 10/100/1000, Accessories radio: Dedicated dual band XBOX Wireless radio'. So Wi-Fi 5 only - no 6 GHz, no 802.11ax - which is a generation behind the PS5's Wi-Fi 6 and a useful contrast in a lab. 867M is the 2x2 802.11ac figure. The accessory radio links controllers, not the network, so it is not declared.
